failure: The variable $LASTEXITCODE cannot be retrieved because it has not been set.
secondaryProtocolFinding: SQLPlus received a UTF-8 BOM before SET ECHO and emitted SP2-0734 even though provisioning statements completed.
rootCause: initialize-cpf-database.ps1 invokes the official Vendor PowerShell runner in-process and then reads strict-mode $LASTEXITCODE. Oracle uses the .NET SQLPlus process wrapper and does not set that automatic variable, unlike the PostgreSQL native-client branch. StandardInputEncoding also uses BOM-emitting Encoding.UTF8.
